prompt:
Retouch the reference photograph. The framing, the camera height, the street,
the open boot full of boxes on the left of the picture, the morning light and
his clothes stay exactly as they are.

What changes is his pose and his face: he stands up very straight with his
chest pushed out and his chin up, grinning from ear to ear, the grin reaching
his eyes. His hand nearer the car has left the box: it is closed in a fist in
front of his chest with the thumb pointing straight up. His other arm hangs
relaxed. He looks towards the right edge of the picture, delighted with
himself.
